rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB label, but it overstates visibility/clarity of structures in this single image, especially describing a relatively uniform TE layer and clear ICM when the image is somewhat limited and not ideal for detailed TE assessment.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, sperm parameters, prior IVF history, and endometrial thickness well, with appropriate emphasis on the thin lining as a major modifier of prognosis.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, linking embryo quality and young age to favorable prognosis while downgrading success due to thin endometrium and endometriosis; minor overconfidence around the magnitude of reduction prevents a top score.

Much of the discussion is broadly evidence-based, but recommending cancellation/freeze-all as the primary course solely for a 6 mm lining is stronger than guideline-based consensus, and suggestions such as ERA, sildenafil, and aspirin are not routinely recommended without specific indications.

Provides clear next-step options for fresh transfer versus freeze-all and outlines future evaluation and endometrial optimization strategies, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard.
